Stop-loss 7.3% below entry and target 14.6% above provides 2:1 risk/reward, but extended ATR ratio of 1.04 indicates volatility is near normal ranges with limited edge.

Price above all three EMAs with consistent 16.2% 20-day return and RSI at 57 in neutral territory shows steady uptrend structure. Extended ATR at 0.43 is notably weak relative to its ATR, signaling reduced volatility and potential for range-bound movement despite the higher target.

20-day return of 20.7% with price 5.3% above EMA20 and 12.9% above EMA50 demonstrates strong intermediate trend, while extended ATR of 1.12 confirms above-average volatility supports the 18% upside target.
